svg.title: DynamicEmb hierarchical input dist: key data flow across four one-GPU nodes
svg.desc: Filled cells are keys; the digit in one is the key's owner rank, not its value, and each rank's input is already unique. Step 1: the bucketize writes inv and the bucket feature of each row, an owner at a time, and moves no key; the push then copies each key through inv, into the own part of node_keys with a local store or into a key_stage slice for its owner node. Step 2: a count message crosses each route first and the rail layout follows from it; then one GIN put with a signal carries each key_stage slice, a chunk header and its key records, into the owner's rail_keys. Step 3: the owner copies the keys into its feature-major KJT and writes a row map, so the lookup output stays in arrival order.
svg.text: 4 nodes × 1 GPU · same 40 keys, already unique on each rank · every remote key crosses InfiniBand in one GIN put
